---
name: framework-status
description: Summarize progress, blockers, and next steps for the FRC Agentic Development Framework Build Pieces.
agent: agent
---

Summarize the current framework status from the repository. Read `docs/framework/build-pieces.md`, `docs/framework/agentic-dev-framework.md`, and `docs/framework/decisions.md`; inspect the relevant files and current git status to verify claims.

Report concisely:
- Each Build Piece's recorded status and any evidence that confirms or contradicts it.
- Completed outputs, in-progress work, blockers, and open decisions that affect upcoming pieces.
- The next eligible Build Piece, based on dependencies and prerequisites.
- Any mismatch between the tracker and files actually present.

Do not change files or statuses. Clearly distinguish facts in the repository from recommendations, and do not claim a piece is complete without checking its done-criteria.
